title: Ceviche de Camarón
description: Ceviche de Camarón is a dish from Ecuador featuring shrimp, lime juice, orange juice, tomato. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. Shrimp are fully heat-cooked before citrus dressing for safety; regional versions vary.

steps.instruction: Fully cook shrimp until opaque and pearly, then chill promptly; citrus juice is not a replacement for cooking.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 30 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
